prompt: Use Spectrum 1-5: page #19161D, text #F6F3F7, accent #E58AB4, secondary surface #373725, text on accent #111111. Use body 20px, heading 48px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Set headings in Archivo and reading text in Libre Baskerville; direct grotesque heading with measured reading serif. Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
